context: Representative front-matter cleanup: add parsing behavior while moving repeated Optional value reads into a helper/Optional boundary.

checklist.name: Compiles and creates requested artifact
checklist.description: Creates a coherent Java 8-compatible WorkflowPortLookup.java with workflowServerPortReservation(Optional<Map<String,Object>>, Path).

checklist.name: Implements Number and String behavior
checklist.description: Returns Optional.of(number.intValue()) for Number values and Optional.of(parsed) for trimmed numeric String values.

checklist.name: Handles absent and invalid values
checklist.description: Returns Optional.empty() without throwing for absent front matter, missing key, null values, blank strings, malformed strings, and unsupported types.

checklist.name: Preserves public contract
checklist.description: Does not expose workflowPath in output and keeps the method signature and Optional<Integer> return contract.

checklist.name: Uses Optional boundary without reopening
checklist.description: Moves map access into an Optional map/flatMap helper or equivalent value-binding shape instead of guarding then reading frontMatter.get().

checklist.name: Avoids null or fake collection workarounds
checklist.description: Does not use orElse(null), local null branching, Optional.stream().toList(), or a loop over one Optional.

checklist.name: Keeps parser readable
checklist.description: Keeps parsing small and local, with clear Number/String handling and no broad exception swallowing beyond malformed numeric input.
